name: Lavender

companions.note: Both are strong pollinator attractors; planting together creates a vibrant insect habitat patch

pnw_notes: Thrives in PNW dry summers but needs excellent drainage to survive wet winters — a raised bed or south-facing slope is ideal. Prune by one third after bloom; never cut into old wood. Visit a specialty nursery in bloom season (June–July) to choose by scent.

planting_windows.notes: Fall planting preferred — roots establish before winter
Spring planting also works; water until established
Cut stems when about half the flowers have opened; hang to dry
